invariants: Published complete disposal is one owned transaction, repeated awaiters receive the same failure instance and Host cause is reported once, with actual structured exit facts retained.

Unpublished ordinary startup failure preserves both protocol and teardown error members in order; canceled startup preserves only the teardown member, with raw causes and actual exit facts after cleanup.
A throwing Host error sink cannot replace the public partial-output process failure or fabricate successful completion.
Canceling Python dispose or startup awaiters cannot orphan the owned real process, RPC, reader or abort listener.
The actual extracted embedded Python 3.8.10 module executes all four selected real-process teardown observations, including causes, protocol and failure identity.
identity: One memoized published disposal Task and failure object, exact original AbortSignal listener identity, and independent physical child per declared observation.
ownership: The run owns complete public disposal and underlying process/RPC drainage; cancellation of an awaiting caller cannot cancel those owned tasks. Host reporting remains contained.
ordering: Observe structured exit after failed cleanup; startup protocol failure precedes cleanup failure in the aggregate. Public repeated disposal joins the same completed or pending transaction.
errors: Fixed safe AcpRunFailure stage/category/exit messages preserve raw Host cause; AggregateError members retain original ordering and identity, with no cause normalization or secret leakage into public diagnostics.
cancellation: Python Task cancellation uses shielded owned teardown; observed canceled startup has no published session. JavaScript Promise cancellation is not invented.
adaptation: Python 3.8 standard-library asyncio and the canonical subprocess service. Source wait rejection is a declared handle seam occurring after actual child exit, not an invented process outcome.
open_questions: Current bounded qualification is recorded in rc1_review. This contract does not certify pathological piped streams, complete process trees, background Jobs, full ACP/SDK or deferred Win7.

rc1_review.scope: Current finite executable provider/consumer corpora, original-browser and extracted observations in the single full receipt. Historical alpha evidence remains historical; no inventory-wide parity, arbitrary ABI/history, paid-provider or Win7 certification.
